messages:
Priya K: Heads up — want to propose adding an optional capacity-hint header to the gateway so routing can prefer Dedicated pools for tenants with reserved capacity. Example: `X-Redwood-Capacity-Hint: pool=dedicated;pref=0.8;tenant=acct-123`

Mike L: Quick q — how would this interact with latency-based failover? If the dedicated pool suddenly spikes we still want to fall back to hosted.

Priya K: Good call. Intent is: header expresses preference not eligibility. Policy would be: prefer pool X if healthy; if latency or error thresholds tripped, follow existing failover. Need a tie-breaker for equal-cost regions though.

Ashley: We should avoid adding another header that becomes a bandaid. Can we expose this as a per-tenant routing profile in the console? UX: tenant -> routing profile -> prefer_dedicated boolean + rollout % toggle.

Mike L: Console toggle is cleaner. Also need telemetry: tag routing.decision={preferred_pool,final_pool,latency_ms,probe_status}. And a metric routing.override_applied (bool) counted per-tenant-hash, not raw tenant id.

Sam R: Telemetry names look good. Also recommend a light probe metric for dedicated pools: region_probe_success and region_probe_rtt_ms so we can eject aggressively without user-impact. Probes must be async and not affect request path.

infra-bot: deploy:gateway-config v2.14 rolled to canary in us-west-2 (12 hosts).

Eva: For rollout plan: canary the header honoring to 5% of tenants with reserved capacity, show active count in console. Console should surface 'is_prefer_dedicated' and link to rollout status + last probe health.

Priya K: I'll draft a proto PR for gateway + console toggle. Sketch header payload in case we need it in logs:
```
X-Redwood-Capacity-Hint: pool=dedicated;pref=0.8;tenant=acct-123
```
We'll also stash the hint in the request context so downstream telemetry can join on request_id.

Mike L: Please canonicalize tenant ids before emitting metrics — use tenant.hash or tenant.bucket to avoid PII. Also add a sampling flag for verbose routing traces (1/1000 requests).

Ashley: :thumbsup: Sounds good. Priya — ping me when you have the console copy and the rollout UX mock, I can review the copy + toggle placement.

Priya K: Will do. Thanks all — I'll open the PR and the console mock today.
